title: Pick a section's color, faces on groups fixed
items: Click the color dot next to a section's name to give it another color. Sections with the same color belong together, so after renaming you can make every verse one color and every chorus another. The timeline and saved projects keep your choice.

Working on an xLights sequence with a singing face on a group or a submodel failed with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'nodes')". Each prop in the group now sings with its own face, and a submodel shows its part of the face.
The section colors were asked for by Larry D., and augustus reported the faces error, both on Discord. Thank you!

title: Change and add words, resize from either end
items: Change the words: double-click a word in the timeline (or press Enter on a picked one) and type the right ones. Typing several words splits its time between them. Double-click a line, or press ✎ in the word list, to retype the whole line.
Add words that were missed: double-click an empty spot in the Words row and type them.
Words can be resized from the right edge too, not only the left.
Asked for by Rogue Killa ZA on Discord. Thank you!

title: Part brightness and loudness, remove words, Reload show
items: A layout with one prop placed far outside the xLights preview area showed only a couple of dots: the preview zoomed out to fit that prop. Props that far away are now left out of the view, and the show line names them so you can move them back in xLights.

Reload your show without starting over: ↻ Reload show reads your show folder again (after changing the layout in xLights), and Pick different files… swaps the files if you picked the wrong ones. Your plan stays.

Remove words that shouldn't be there, like an "Ah-ha" it heard in the music: click a word in the timeline and press Delete, press ✕ on a line in the word list, or remove all the filled-in sounds at once. Ctrl+Z brings them back.

Brightness and Loudness for each part: open a part to dim or brighten all its lights (0 to 200%), or tell the ideas how lively it should be. 🎲 Randomize then makes an idea at that loudness. ↺ puts either back.
The preview fix and Reload show were found and suggested by Fame28, and removing words by Rogue Killa ZA, both on Discord. Thank you!

title: Randomize one row, palette colors, filter and sort rows
items: Every light row has its own 🎲 next to Solo and Mute: just those lights get a new effect and colors, from the part's palette and your effect choices. Press again for another; ↶ takes that row back a step (Undo works too).

Click a row's colors (or 🎨 in its settings) for a palette box: pick one of the row's colors, then any color in the grid or one already in the part, or click one of your palettes to set them all at once.

Parts with many rows get a filter box above them: type a light or an effect (like "mega" or "chase") to show only those rows, and a Sort list: as planned, lights A–Z, effect A–Z or when it plays. Sorting only changes the list, not the sequence's layers.
All of these were suggested by Fame28 on Discord. Thank you!

title: Solo no longer blanks the preview
items: Removing a light row you had soloed left the whole preview dark, because it still showed only that missing row. Solo and Mute now let go of rows that are gone. Thanks to Jeff Lauterbach for the fix!

title: Guide and tour up to date
items: The guide (How to use), the Show me around tour and the page notes now cover everything new: every xLights effect, the Effects for props tab, profiles from your own sequences, Singing face on any prop with a face, rows that show their props first, and where to find files with Choose….

title: Profiles: ideas that sequence like you
items: Profiles from your own sequences: on the 🎛 Effects for props tab, choose a folder of finished xLights sequences, tick which ones to learn from, and the app learns which effects you use on each prop, how often, and with which settings. Ideas, Another idea and 🎲 Randomize then sequence more like you do.

Build a profile for every kind of prop, or only the ones you pick (just the mega tree, say), with Select all / Deselect all for both lists. Single props can get their own column too, and groups made of them follow it.
Profiles are saved in a Profile list: switch between them, change and save them, rename, delete, go back to Default, and export / import them as files.

title: Light rows show their props first, and Singing face is easy to find
items: Each light row now starts with its props, then the effect ("All Flood · Color wash" instead of "Color wash · All Flood"), so it's easier to find the row for a prop. Thanks to Fame28 on Discord for the suggestion!

Singing face was hard to find: it only showed in the Effect list when the row was set to a singing option, which stays off until the words are found. It now shows on any row whose lights include a prop with a face set up in xLights (first in the list for those props), with a reminder to find the words when they are missing. Thanks to Fame28 for asking!

title: Words on the matrix no longer go missing
items: Words on the matrix skipped some lines: a line sung just before a chorus started ("We got dust on our Bibles" in Dusty Bibles) showed nothing, and a line running over into the next part stopped after its first word. Each sung line now belongs to the part that holds most of it and shows in full. In Dusty Bibles that brings back 28 of 66 chorus words. Rows on sung words, notes or singing work the same way. Export again to get the fix in xLights.

title: A new name: SequenceStarter
items: Lights Auto Sequencer is now SequenceStarter: a head start on your xLights sequences. Another project already uses the name Auto Sequencer, so this one has its own. It has a new address too: https://socman1984-hub.github.io/SequenceStarter/ (old links and the QR code forward there). Your saved projects and settings are all still there.

title: Every xLights effect, and you choose which ones ideas use
items: Every xLights effect is now in the app: Fire, Candle, Fireworks, Lightning, Snowstorm, Galaxy, Circles, Shapes, Plasma, Shimmer, Fill, Garlands, Tree, Life, Lines, Tendril, Liquid, Text, Single Strand Skips and its 118 strip (WLED) patterns, VU Meter that follows the music, Music, Piano, Guitar, Warp, Kaleidoscope, Adjust, Duplicate, State, DMX, Servo, Sketch, Glediator, and Pictures, Video and Shader by hand. The Effect list in a light row is grouped by kind.

🎛 Effects for props: a new tab with a grid of every effect against every kind of prop. Set how often ideas, Another idea and 🎲 Randomize pick each effect for each kind of prop (blank = never), for steady looks and for hits on beats and drums.

Default keeps what the app has always picked, and Every effect adds a little of everything. Change numbers, then Save your own sets under a name, go back to Default any time, and Export / Import them as a file to share.
Choose… next to a picture, video, shader or recording lists the files in your show folder.

The new effects preview the way xLights renders them: each was checked against xLights itself, and most match it pixel for pixel. Random ones (fireworks, snow, sparkles) match it in look and amount of light.

Warp, Kaleidoscope and Adjust change the row under them, as in xLights (Canvas mode); ideas give them a look to work on. Piano and Guitar play the sung melody from a new Vocal Notes timing track in the export.
Imported xLights sequences now preview these effects too, instead of a dim shimmer.
Effect settings are written so every supported xLights version reads them the same, including keys that changed in xLights 2026.

title: Words for songs that repeat more than their lyrics
items: Find words left parts of a song with singing but no words when the pasted lyrics list a chorus fewer times than the song sings it (common in dance and extended mixes). Those repeats are now added where they're sung.
Sung sounds like "Ah-ah", "Ooh" or "Yeah" that the speech model can't hear as words: if your lyrics include such a line, every stretch of singing still without words gets it, timed to the sung notes.

title: Proper render order and the full layout in exported sequences
items: Exported sequences list every prop and group from your layout (unused ones stay empty), like a sequence started in xLights, so your master view is all there.

Render order: groups at the top (rendered at the back), then props, each by name, the order xLights' "sort: groups at top by name" gives. A prop's own effect now shows over a group effect. Imported sequences keep their own order. Thanks to the Discord member who suggested it!
The preview draws rows in that same order, a later row over earlier ones, as xLights does.

The guide (How to use), the Show me around tour and the page notes now cover everything new: importing xLights sequences, zoom and Props only, randomizing the whole sequence, part colors, Halloween colors, prop names in other languages and the render order.

title: Pan + zoom the preview, and a props-only view you control by clicking
items: Zoom the preview: scroll to zoom in/out on whatever's under the cursor (like a map), or use the − / + buttons next to Line up photo — from 50% to 600%. Click the zoom percentage to reset.
Pan around once zoomed in: drag with the middle mouse button, or Shift+scroll to pan sideways.

💡 Props only, next to Pop out: click a prop on the house to select it (Ctrl/⌘-click, or drag a box, to pick more than one), then Props only hides everything else — the house photo and every other prop — and frames just what you picked, centered. Click Full view, or the hint's button, to go back. If you turn it on before picking anything, it fits all your props instead and shows a hint asking you to click one.
Thanks to MGXAe for this one: the zoom, panning and Props only view are their contribution!

title: Import xLights sequences, Halloween colors and per-part colors
items: Import xLights sequences: File › Import xLights sequence (.xsq) brings in a sequence made in xLights with every effect exactly as it was. Change its lights or colors, mute or remove rows, or add new lights on top; the export gives back everything you didn't change, untouched (checked: a 3,619-effect sequence comes back byte-for-byte the same in xLights).
Halloween color schemes: Halloween (orange, purple, green), Orange & purple, Green & purple, Red & orange. They're added to your list even if you've edited your schemes.
🎲 Randomize the whole sequence: a button above the parts that gives every part new lights at once (each part's own 🎲 Randomize still changes just that part).

A part's 🎲 Randomize went back to the palette in Idea settings even after you changed that part's colors. A part you recolor (its 🎨, or by editing its rows' colors) now keeps its own colors for new ideas, shown as "own colors" on its card; ✕ goes back to the main palette.
The 🎨 color window now opens on the scheme the part last had applied, instead of always the same one.
Props named in French, Spanish, German or Dutch (étoile, sapin, flocon, maison, estrella, Stern, sneeuwvlok…) are now recognized, so ideas use them without adding them by hand.

In the Prop mix, props you added yourself now say "added by you" with a Remove button (the old ✕ looked like the prop was crossed out), and the window explains what to do with props it can't recognize.

Imported sequences look much closer to xLights in the preview: moving settings (value curves), full-size pinwheels, driving snowflakes, pictures from your show folder, rotated, flipped and spinning effects, transparent On and Off, the Average blend, group sizes and row order. On a test sequence, bulbs xLights lights that the preview missed went from 17% to 7%.
Color Wash in the preview now goes through its colors once (as xLights does) instead of wrapping back to the first; Shockwave rings use xLights' exact size and width.
Imported Shader effects now play in the preview (the .fs files from your show folder, run in the browser), and imported Video effects play the video files from your show folder in step with the song.

title: Preview fix from the community
items: Props placed outside xLights' preview area are no longer cut off in the preview. Thanks to computergeek1507 for the first community contribution!

title: Opening projects fix
items: Opening another project while scrolled down looked like it did nothing: the note asking for the project's song was hidden behind the song bar. It now stays in view at the top until you answer it.
"Opened the project" notes clear themselves after a few seconds.

title: New effects, layered looks and pro techniques
items: Ten new effects: Fan, Ripple, Spirograph, Wave, Meteors, Curtain, Morph, Snowflakes, Strobe, Off (dark) and a Beat meter that flashes or sweeps on every beat or bar. Checked against xLights' own render.
Restart every beat or bar: a steady row becomes short effects that turn round or change color each time, the way most pro sequences are built.
Masks: a row can be a moving shape that shows the colors of the row under it only where it's lit, or cuts them out.
On a group: "Every prop the same" makes every spinner, snowflake or wreath show exactly the same picture (xLights' Overlay).
Per row: Fade in / Fade out, Sparkles (optionally with the music), Comes in / Goes (wipe or circle burst), and Spin (the whole picture turns).
Pinwheel, Spirals and Bars get xLights' 3D look; pinwheel arms can grow or pulse, spirals can wobble, shockwaves can rise or fall.
New triggers: hi-hat hits, the music's hits (note onsets) and each sung note. The export adds a Note Onsets timing track.
Parts can now come in with a wipe or a circle burst.

Ideas learned from 56 of the owner's own sequences and three pro ones: chopped rows in lively parts, 3D looks, sparkles, the new effects on the props they suit, fast hits on spinners and snowflakes, masks on the matrix and mega tree, and props made of parts lit part by part.

title: Older xLights versions
items: The page lists which xLights versions work: show folders from xLights 2021 or newer; saved sequences open in xLights 2023 or newer; moving-head effects need xLights 2024.10 or newer.
Export option for xLights older than 2024.10: leave out the moving-head effects.
If something goes wrong, a note says so, with Copy details to paste into Discord #bugs.
The show line names your layout's xLights version, and any props that couldn't be read.
One prop that can't be read (or an odd submodel or face) no longer stops the whole show from loading; very old layouts with groups in the model list load too.

title: Moving heads, a File menu and a pop-out preview
items: Moving heads: a Moving head effect (pattern, size, aim, speed, spread between heads, brightness, colors) that xLights renders with its own Moving Head effect. Tested in an xLights render.
Moving heads are drawn in the preview as fixtures with beams that sweep in their color.

Moving heads box: choose which parts of the song the heads join, add or re-roll just the heads without touching anything else, and set how big they look in the preview. Each part also has + Moving heads.
Ideas and 🎲 Randomize include moving heads: slow, small shapes in quiet parts, big fast ones in loud parts.
File menu: open a song or project, recent projects, Save, Save as, Auto-save and Export, like any program. The project's name shows beside it, with a • while there are unsaved changes.
⤓ Export to xLights (Ctrl+E): one dialog to save the .xsq into your show folder or download it.
⧉ Pop out: the preview in its own window, handy on a second screen.
Step tracker under the tabs: Song › Words › Your show › Plan the lights › Export, ticking off as you go.
What's new (this list) and when the website was last updated.
Matrices get a layered look (a base plus a lighter effect on top), and big singing props like a snow globe get a background with the face on top.
Round props (snowflakes, spinners, wreaths, stars) share each other's moves, and names like "ChromaFlake" count as snowflakes.
Image props are drawn as their picture, glowing in the light's color.
Moving heads set to "No Controller" in xLights were skipped by ideas and Randomize.

title: Tester feedback round: guide, projects, transitions and more
items: How to use guide and a Show me around tour in the app.
More prop types in the preview: circles, icicles, candy canes, spinners, wreaths, spheres, multi-point and channel blocks, and older xLights files.
Prop types…: tell ideas what a prop is when its name doesn't say.
Projects: recent projects to switch between, a projects folder, and Save / Don't save / Cancel before switching. Auto-save.
📝 Words on the matrix: put the sung words on your matrix in the parts you choose.
Only the part that's playing: the plan shows just the part you hear and follows the song.
The control boxes above the plan can be folded and rearranged (unlock the layout first).
Each part shows how it comes in (ramp up, sweep in, burst, color hit, crossfade…) and you can change it.
Discord link for ideas, bugs and help.
Going into a chorus no longer goes dark and flashes white every time: each lift gets its own transition.
A new start screen, and the controls above the plan grouped into Ideas, Change what's planned and View.
Same look for parts with the same name is off by default, with a clearer explanation.
Opening a project kept asking where the MP3 is: now one click (and Chrome/Edge can allow it on every visit).
Props that aren't in your show (from another layout, or renamed) are never written into the sequence; a note offers to swap them.
Suggest a plan crashed on props whose type couldn't be guessed.

title: First public version
items: Load an MP3: tempo, beats, bars, song parts, loud and quiet sections and drum hits are found for you.
Find the words: voice separation and speech recognition, matched to your lyrics, for singing faces and timing tracks.
Open your xLights show folder and watch the plan on a preview of your own house.
Suggest a plan and 🎲 Randomize, with feeling, intensity, color schemes, prop mix and props to leave out.
Lights that follow the music: louder parts brighter and fuller, the beat on one or two props, build-ups into choruses, and a fit-with-the-music score.
Save projects, and export an .xsq for xLights with Beats, Bars, Song Parts and Lyrics timing tracks.
Free and open source (GPLv3). Everything runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
